case: Computed BLOB with valid UTF-8 bytes remains a byte value
contract: A computed CAST('text blob' AS BLOB) result is Value::Bytes even though its byte sequence is valid UTF-8.
Native typeof() reports BLOB and native hex() reports 7465787420626C6F62, independently checking runtime class and exact bytes.
Integer, real, text, SQL NULL, aggregate text and valid-UTF-8 BLOB expression results share one dynamic-result query without changing their Value variants.
